candidates.name: Existing UAR typed prompt/turn, routing, persistence and governed evaluation seams
candidates.fit_for_gap: F1-F8; especially destination templates, protected budget planning and production-host verification

evidence.claim: Inspected local source renders typed fragments with two family preference booleans; extend existing seam.
Inspected reducer can drop severed tool groups; new protected preservation requires a stronger contract.
Existing Liter adapter remains the inference boundary; versions.toml pins Liter1.18.2.

risks: Canonical spec currently requires ingest truncation and permits whole-group dropping; explicit deltas required.
Behavior and compile health remain unverified in this stage.
candidates.decision_rationale: Preserve capability inversion and established host integration; implement missing contracts rather than replacing runtime.

candidates.name: tiktoken-rs (existing 0.12.0 dependency)
candidates.fit_for_gap: F2/F3 model-keyed text tokenization inside destination accounting

evidence.claim: Repository search confirms Rust tokenizer project and MIT license.
Context7 identifies model-to-tokenizer lookup; main documentation does not certify pinned-version whole-request or multimodal accounting.
Registry retrieval failed TLS validation and HTTP403; no current release claim is made.

risks: Not a complete provider request counter.
Fallback encoding is not a proof of a hard bound.
Tool schemas, multimodal content, framing and output reservation require host accounting.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse existing dependency via a counting adapter; retain0.12.0 and verify exact pinned behavior before implementation.

candidates.name: Hugging Face model chat-template conventions
candidates.fit_for_gap: F2/F3 raw-inference model-specific serialization and tool representation

evidence.claim: Official guide explains differing model control tokens and duplicate-special-token hazards.
Official guide describes tool schemas, calls and results within model chat formatting.

risks: Main documentation is not a pinned UAR dependency contract.
Hosted chat endpoints may own chat serialization; applying raw templates twice is incorrect.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reference model-owned serialization semantics; do not introduce Transformers or Python into the host.

candidates.name: MiniJinja
candidates.fit_for_gap: F2 optional future declarative template engine

evidence.claim: Repository search identifies a Rust Jinja-compatible template engine.
Context7 surfaced template inspection interfaces on main; no pinned compatibility or sandbox guarantee established.
Registry retrieval failed; version and MSRV not certified.

risks: Programmable templates introduce complexity beyond proven requirements.
Version, feature gates and execution/output limits require separate verification before adoption.
candidates.decision_rationale: Current typed renderer can implement versioned model templates; defer adding an engine until a concrete unsupported template requirement exists.

candidates.name: LLMLingua

evidence.claim: Repository search identifies a prompt-compression project.
Project describes removing nonessential tokens. Inference: as-is whole-prompt compression does not meet this phase's protected-data preservation contract.

risks: Lossy protected-data compression is prohibited regardless of aggregate task-quality scores.
No phase-specific performance or preservation evaluation was run.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reject as the runtime budget/preservation solution. A future prose-only compressor would still need the host protection boundary and separate evidence.

candidates.name: Rig
candidates.fit_for_gap: F1/F6/F7 alternative Rust LLM application framework

evidence.claim: Repository search identifies a modular Rust LLM application framework; detailed API evaluation not pursued after scope rejection.

risks: Replacing existing governed UAR/Liter architecture is outside phase scope.
No evidence establishes an as-is match for UAR's protected-data contract.
candidates.decision_rationale: Retain current host seams and dependency authority rather than undertake a framework migration.

build_required.need: F2 versioned provider/endpoint/model templates and per-attempt request preparation
build_required.why_no_candidate: A template engine cannot decide UAR policy precedence, exact endpoint compatibility, mandatory fragment retention or safe failover.

build_required.need: F3 pure protected-context budget planner, whole-request counting and lossless group preservation
build_required.why_no_candidate: Tokenizers count selected representations; they do not classify host data, reserve output, govern summarization or handle protected overflow.

build_required.need: F3 canonical raw tool-result acquisition and incomplete-history migration
build_required.why_no_candidate: Existing ingestion truncates; preservation requires host-owned records and explicit resource-limit outcomes before formatting.
Must extend the existing policy-aware router using actual prepared-request feasibility, not add a separate framework.
